media.prompt: Create ONE production-ready photorealistic vehicle render asset for a guided camera transition. Reference 1 is the EXACT cream and black vintage Chrysler Roadster, same black canvas roof up, chrome radiator, black fenders, whitewall tires and vintage wheels. Cabin has exactly the reference wood-rim three-spoke steering wheel, black dashboard with cream-on-black round gauges, pleated black leather bench and long slender floor shifter. Preserve its car identity, geometry, wheels, paint, roof, soft fixed studio lighting, camera angle, position, scale and landscape canvas. Reference 2 shows its cabin details, use only for continuity. Make exactly one physical change: OPEN the near-side LEFT DRIVER'S DOOR outward about 65 degrees on its proper front hinge, revealing the driver's seat and cabin behind it. The front of the car remains pointing LEFT in the frame as reference 1, same front-left three-quarter camera. Whole car AND open door fully inside canvas with comfortable margins. Do not swing open the passenger side. Do not shift the camera, do not add extra doors, people, captions, overlays, logos outside the car or watermarks. True transparent RGBA background everywhere outside the vehicle, including beneath and around the wheels: remove all floor and cast shadow. No black rectangle, no floor reflection, no fake transparency checkerboard. Only the isolated car with natural self-shadows. 16:9 wide composition, 1920x1080 preferred. This should align with the closed-door reference when overlaid in a web scene.

Create ONE premium photorealistic automotive cockpit render. Move the camera physically INSIDE, exactly at the LEFT DRIVER'S EYE POSITION, pointing forwards through the windshield, horizontal level. This is a new rendered viewpoint, not a crop. Use a natural wide-angle 24mm lens with straight believable geometry, wide panoramic 16:9 full bleed. Camera low enough to feel seated, not looking in from outside and no visible person, arms or legs. Maintain exact era, dashboard layout, colors, gauges, wheel design and upholstery from references. Wood/chrome only for the classic, black Alcantara/white dials/three spokes only for red GT3, black four-spoke rectangular-center wheel/black dials/orange needles only for white 930. Soft fixed studio lighting, bright enough to read all cabin details but deep natural blacks, no glow cones, no other cars, no showroom. Not a fisheye, no UI, titles, labels or watermark. Foreground wheel and shifter feel physically close, windshield gives depth. Output one 16:9 landscape image, 1920x1080 preferred.
